observations: A solid black rounded mass sits left of center, with two arm-like extensions reaching outward and a thin diagonal line rising to the upper-right corner.
Roughly a dozen jagged zigzag lines radiate from the black mass in all directions across a flat, saturated yellow field that fills the entire background.
Small scrawled marks cluster near the lower edge of the black mass; the artist's signature appears in the lower-left corner as loose black linework.
reading: A black form hangs from a single taut line against an unbroken yellow field, its radiating zigzag strokes pulling the eye outward in every direction. The contrast between the still, heavy mass and the restless lines around it reads as tension—something caught between falling and holding. The scrawled marks at the form's base add a note of fragility to an otherwise stark image.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work stands apart from its title neighbor nnxyz nnotb #113, which fills its field with layered color and dense marks. Here a single black form on yellow reduces the vocabulary to near-minimum, making the radiating lines carry almost all the weight.

connections.reason: Both works use lines spreading outward from a central mass, but nnxyz nnotb #113 layers those lines over dense multicolor marks while nnxyz nnotb #114 strips the field to a single yellow, sharpening the contrast.

lookingQuestion: Where does your eye settle first—on the point where the thin line meets the black mass, or on the outermost tips of the radiating zigzags—and what does that path of attention do to the sense of weight in the image?
ambiguities: The scrawled marks at the base of the black mass may include lettering or may be purely abstract; their content is unclear at this resolution.
nnxyz nnotb #115 (soft blended figure, pale palette) and nnxyz nifty faces #54 (dense multicolor face) share no strong formal connection with this work and were omitted.

imageReview.method: Original PNG supplied to separate multimodal drafting and review calls
reviewFindings: All three observations confirmed against the primary image: rounded black mass left of center, taut diagonal line to upper-right, radiating zigzags on flat yellow, scrawled marks at base, and signature lower-left are all visible.

Comparison with QmdPNKuc7M7XniKpLJgqWmE2pKW4Ai2o42W717qkWEcVHF confirmed: #113 does show radiating lines from a central mass over dense multicolor layering, making the formal contrast with #114's minimal yellow field accurate and specific.
